'''Jack O' Murderer''' is an enemy in [[Ninja Gaiden (NES)|''Ninja Gaiden'']]''.''

=='''[[Ninja Gaiden (NES)|Ninja Gaiden]]'''== 
[[File:JackOMurdererNES1.png|80px]]

First appearing in [[Basilisk Mine Field|Act 4-2]], Jack O' Murderers are potentially one of the most dangerous enemies in the game. They are a palette swap of the [[Banshee]]s and do the same thing, their weapon of choice being machetes. Both their contact and machete attacks do 1 damage, and they are best defeated using sub-weapons to work around the machete.
